methods.name: Quest skip to level 31
methods.note: Holy Grail gives 15,300 Defence XP for level 31. Dragon Slayer I adds 18,650 Defence and 18,650 Strength XP. Olaf's Quest gives 12,000 Defence.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab
methods.note: Tlati Rainforest. No defence, infinite HP, no food, two clicks every 10 minutes and gems. No rate on the wiki, so it is estimated from your Attack and Strength levels.

methods.name: Ammonite or sand crabs
methods.note: Sand crabs in Hosidius need nothing, ammonite crabs need Bone Voyage. Aggressive for 10 minutes, then reset. Estimated: near the Gemstone Crab rate, less at high levels.

methods.name: Defensive bursting maniacal monkeys
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon: Monkey Madness II started is enough; bring a light source. Ice Burst on the defensive style gives 1 Defence XP a damage beside Magic XP. Max hit 25.

methods.name: Brutus
methods.note: Cow boss in the Lumbridge cow field, free-to-play. Gives double combat XP and is back in 8 seconds once you ring the cowbell amulet. Dodge his charge and stomp.

methods.name: Vyrewatch Sentinels
methods.note: Darkmeyer with the blisterwood flail, praying melee. Guide says up to 54k and about 130k gp an hour in alchs. After The Blood Moon Rises carry a garlic cocktail.

methods.name: Sulphur naguas
methods.note: Neypotzli: Perilous Moons started is enough. Pray melee on moonlight potions made on site (38 Herblore). Glacial temotli or sulphur blades, dual macuahuitl from 75.

methods.name: Scurrius
methods.note: Varrock Sewers rat boss. Solo the public-room version with a bone mace for 100k or more at base 70 stats. The mace needs a 1 in 33 spine drop. Takes focus.

methods.name: Nightmare Zone
methods.note: North of Yanille. Normal rumble on absorption potions: one click every 20 minutes. Overloads add XP but need a sip every 5. Needs 5 eligible quests and a 22,000 coin fee.

methods.name: Slayer tasks with melee
methods.note: The ironman guide's main source of melee XP, since the whip, dragon boots and other gear are locked behind Slayer. Slayer helm boosts damage on task. No rate given.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon: Monkey Madness II started is enough, and bring a light source. Hallowfell hits up to three stacked monkeys. Auto retaliate alone gives less.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys with a Hallowfell drop
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon: Monkey Madness II started is enough, and bring a light source. Hallowfell is a rare drop from the Mad Angel, fought after Fallen From Grace.

methods.name: Gargoyles
methods.note: Slayer Tower with a rock hammer. Upwards of 700k gp an hour in alchable drops. Rate is for a whip or scimitar; a granite hammer at 230 kills an hour gives about 97k.

unverified: Quest skip: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0)

Gemstone Crab: no wiki page gives a melee XP rate (checked 11 October 2026); the rate is the wiki's damage formula in shared/domain/rates.ts (calc crab-melee, rewritten 12 October 2026): the scimitar the Attack level allows (dragon from 60, which needs Monkey Madness I), an amulet of strength, a combat bracelet, climbing boots and a berserker helm from 40, and Barrows gloves, a dragon defender, dragon boots and a fighter torso from 70, taken from the lower of Attack and Strength; no potion or prayer; the gear is an assumption, and 10 strength bonus either way moves the rate about 6% from 70

Ammonite or sand crabs: no rate on any page; uses the Gemstone Crab estimate (calc crab-melee); a kill-by-kill simulation on 11 October 2026 put ammonite crabs with three spawns at 85 to 102% of the estimate as it then was up to level 80 and sand crabs 10 to 33% below it from 80; the estimate has since risen 6 to 14% between 60 and 80, so it runs high for sand crabs from about 60

Vyrewatch Sentinels: the only stated figure is 'up to 54,000 combat XP per hour' with no level or gear; the bands are a damage-formula model (flail, super combat, 85% uptime) that reaches it at 99; lv 50 is the flail's Attack requirement

Sulphur naguas: Perilous Moons only needs starting, which req cannot say, so req asks for the whole quest and is stricter than the game; the guide says to expect 75k at 60 Strength and up to 130k at 75 with Blood Moon armour and Piety, so the 55 band is the 60 figure and 110,000 is 85% of the 130k; no figure exists above 75; making moonlight potions takes 38 Herblore; attention is kept as AFK though a money making guide calls the activity moderate

Scurrius: the guide heads the section levels 55 to 75 and gives one rate, 100k or more at base 70 stats with a bone mace against the public-room version; 79,000 at 55 is a damage model with a super combat potion (97,900 at 70 by the same model), and the first few dozen kills before the 1 in 33 spine drop are slower

Nightmare Zone: 70,000 is the Ironman Guide figure for base 70 stats; the 80 and 90 bands add the 800 XP a level from Nightmare Zone/Strategies; the main guide lists NMZ from 60 with no rate; the 5-quest requirement cannot be expressed in req
Slayer tasks with melee: no melee XP rate on any page (xph 0), the Slayer guides rate tasks in Slayer XP only; lv 70 is the Ironman Slayer guide's recommended 70+ melee stats

Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell (both entries): the guide gives one figure, 200k or more with good stacking, targeting and crystal halberd specials, and no level; 170,000 is 85% of it; the ironman efficiency table (186,400 for Attack) predates the sword; Monkey Madness II only needs starting, which req cannot say; Kruk's Dungeon needs a light source, an item req cannot state
Gargoyles: 60,000 is a model for a whip, scaled to the money making guide's 230 kills an hour with a granite hammer (96,600 XP)
Defensive bursting maniacal monkeys: 88,800 is the strategy page's measured Ice Burst table at max hit 25; Ice Barrage from 94 Magic gives 106,600 or more; lv 1 because no Defence level is needed

Brutus: no page gives an hourly rate; the bands are a damage model (a scimitar for the level, amulet of strength, no potions, cowbell rung each kill: 21.8k at 20, 42.1k at 40, 65.4k at 60, 74.1k at 70) less a fifth for dodging; the double XP, the 58 Hitpoints and the 7.8 second respawn are from his page, and the free-to-play melee guide lists him for levels 20 to 99
All rates: melee XP per hour depends mainly on Strength level and gear, the guides do not give separate rates per skill, so the same figure is used in attack, strength and defence

Not included: Pest Control points (neither melee guide lists it, its figures were the Ranged guide's, and nothing supported offering it to ironmen only); Long-fuse chinning maniacal monkeys (its only figure (181,000) is from the best-gear, high-effort table with two alts stacking, and no ordinary figure exists); Soul Wars zeal, which would qualify on the same reward-formula reasoning as Pest Control
